label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for the day 1 eighteen-hundred great-hall presentation, with its full occasion concealed from me. The innkeeper requested arrival only when setup finishes; builder paid baker materials for forty-four loaves, and baker promised delivery while withholding the private order's occasion and arrangements. The bread's connection to the presentation is plausible but not confirmed. Secretary knowingly helps arrange the appointment and written supplement, but there is no evidence secretary knows the concealed purpose.
